name: Recital 14
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: 1. Following the adoption of the decision referred to in Article 10(3), the Commission shall disburse the total amount set out in that decision to the competent authorities. By derogation from Article 196(3) of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509, the Commission support will be paid to exportproductions already completed.
